DuckDB-Wasm is Copyright 2018-2025 Stichting DuckDB Foundation, licensed under MIT.
The upstream package, version, commit and npm integrity are recorded in upstream.json.

OPFS spill support is based on the pre-registered temporary handle pool proposed
by dt in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-wasm/pull/2138 and previously shipped in
ramSeraph/duckdb-wasm, commit 02b33e04.

This distribution carries the PR's explicit-registration API and original
temporary handle pool, with stale filename mappings cleared when handles are
reused. Automatic registration from SQL/configuration is omitted. The CDN asset
path matches geoparquet-extractor's package layout. Direct I/O and thread settings
are configured by the extractor. It uses upstream Wasm and rebuilds the client
and workers from the pinned npm package's original sources and Emscripten glue.

Other bundled dependencies retain their notices in the licenses directory.
